trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State the need for a cardiology follow-up.
steps.text: నమస్తే. నాకు cardiology follow-up కావాలి.

steps.purpose: Ask for patient ID to begin booking.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా. Appointment book చేయడానికి, మీ patient ID చెబుతారా?

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID and volunteer context.
steps.text: నా patient ID PT-1001. Last month నాకు chest pain వచ్చింది, అందుకే మళ్ళీ doctor ని కలవాలి.

steps.purpose: Ask for verification factors.
steps.text: Okay, PT-1001. Verification కోసం మీ registered name మరియు date of birth చెబుతారా?

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors.
steps.text: నా పేరు రమేష్. Date of birth 15th May 1980.

steps.purpose: Verify user identity before accessing records.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and announce record lookup.
steps.text: Thank you రమేష్ గారు. మీ details verify అయ్యాయి. నేను ఒకసారి మీ record lookup చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Look up patient record to confirm registration and department.
Return patient record details.
Ask for preferred timeframe for the appointment.
steps.text: మీ record చూశాను. మీరు last time cardiology department లో consult అయ్యారు. మీకు ఎన్ని days లో appointment కావాలి?

steps.purpose: State preference for next week, ideally Monday.
steps.text: Next week లో కావాలి. Monday లోపు ఉంటే better.

steps.purpose: Announce checking slots.
steps.text: నేను cardiology department లో next 7 days కి slots check చేస్తాను. ఒక నిమిషం line లో ఉండండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the wait.
steps.text: సరే, త్వరగా చూడండి.

steps.purpose: Check for available slots in cardiology for the next 7 days.
Return available slots.
Offer the available slot and disclose fee.
steps.text: Next week లో Thursday 11:00 AM కి Dr. Rao గారితో మాత్రమే slot ఉంది. Consultation fee 600 rupees. ఇది book చేయమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Restate figures to confirm understanding.
steps.text: Thursday 11:00 AM ఆ? 600 rupees fee అన్నారు, correct ఏ నా?

steps.purpose: Confirm the figures restated by the user.
steps.text: అవును, fee 600 rupees మరియు Thursday 11:00 AM కి slot ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Ask a clarifying question about cancellation.
steps.text: కానీ నాకు కొంచెం doubt గా ఉంది, appointment confirm అయ్యాక cancel చేయవచ్చా? నేను ముందెప్పుడూ cancel చేయలేదు.
steps.clean_text: కానీ నాకు కొంచెం doubt గా ఉంది, appointment confirm అయ్యాక cancel చేయవచ్చా? నేను ముందెప్పుడూ cancel చేయలేదు.
steps.model_visible_text: కానీ నాకు కొంచెం doubt గా ఉంది, appointment confirm అయ్యాక cancel చేయవచ్చా? నేను ముందెప్పుడూ cancel చేయలేదు.

steps.purpose: Answer clarifying question about cancellation.
steps.text: మీరు appointment confirm అయ్యాక కావాలంటే cancel చేసుకోవచ్చు. నేను ఈ slot book చేయనా?

steps.purpose: Hesitate and ask for Monday again.
steps.text: Monday ఏం లేదా? నాకు తొందరగా చూపించుకోవాలి.

steps.purpose: Reiterate available slot when user asks for an alternative.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, Monday రోజు cardiology లో slots లేవు. Thursday మాత్రమే available ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Agree to the available slot and ask for clinical advice.
steps.text: సరే, Thursday book చేయండి. కానీ నాకు అప్పుడప్పుడు నీరసంగా ఉంటుంది, ఇది serious problem అంటావా?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice and announce booking.
steps.text: నేను clinical advice ఇవ్వలేను. దయచేసి ఈ విషయం మీరు Dr. Rao గారితో consult అయినప్పుడు అడగండి. నేను ఇప్పుడు మీ appointment confirm చేస్తున్నాను.

steps.purpose: Book the appointment.
Return booking confirmation.
Provide booking reference and confirm details.
steps.text: మీ appointment confirm అయింది. మీ booking reference REF-456. Thursday 11:00 AM కి Dr. Rao గారితో.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge confirmation and thank the agent.
steps.text: REF-456, okay. Thank you అండి.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The conversation consistently uses natural native verb constructions with English nouns, such as 'book చేయడానికి', 'verify అయ్యాయి', 'lookup చేస్తాను', 'check చేస్తాను', and 'cancel చేయవచ్చా'.
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Code Switch Response Style > Natural Verb Construction

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly bases all provided details (doctor name, day, time, fee, booking reference) on the tool outputs and makes no unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e20, the user claims 'నేను first time వస్తున్నాను' (I am coming for the first time), which directly contradicts their earlier statements that they need a follow-up (e1) and have visited before (e3), as well as the tool result establishing them as an existing patient.
issues.repair_instruction: Replace 'నేను first time వస్తున్నాను' with a contextually appropriate reason for asking about cancellation, such as 'నేను ముందెప్పుడూ cancel చేయలేదు' (I have never cancelled before).

issues.detail: In e24, the user states 'నా గుండె నొప్పి మళ్ళీ వస్తుంది' (my chest pain is coming back). Chest pain is a high-risk symptom that should trigger the escalation condition ('Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency.'). The agent fails to escalate and instead books a routine appointment for days later, which is a clinical safety risk.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the user's utterance in e24 to ask about a non-emergency symptom (e.g., 'నాకు అప్పుడప్పుడు నీరసంగా ఉంటుంది' - I feel weak sometimes) so that the agent's refusal of clinical advice and continuation of the booking remains appropriate without triggering the emergency escalation condition.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the target variants, persona traits, and script mode. However, it contains a logical contradiction regarding the patient's visit history and a critical policy violation where the agent fails to escalate a medical emergency symptom (recurrent chest pain).

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently uses natural code-switched verb constructions such as 'book చేయడానికి' (e2), 'verify అయ్యాయి' (e8), 'check చేస్తాను' (e13), and 'confirm చేస్తున్నాను' (e25).
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Code Switch Response Style > Natural Verb Construction

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses in the tool outputs, accurately quoting the doctor's name, day, time, fee, and booking reference without inventing any details or making forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The terminal success condition requires the appointment to be confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time, and fee. The final confirmation utterance in e28 omits the fee.
issues.repair_instruction: Update the assistant's utterance to include the consultation fee in the final confirmation summary (e.g., add 'Consultation fee 600 rupees.').

However, the final confirmation utterance misses the fee, which is explicitly required by the terminal success condition. A minor surface repair is needed to append the fee to the final message.

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently blends English nouns with native Telugu verbs naturally (e.g., 'book చేయడానికి', 'verify అయ్యాయి', 'lookup చేస్తాను', 'check చేస్తాను').

variant_findings.reason: The variant requires no unsupported forward guarantees about what happens after the call ends. In e21, the agent guarantees that the appointment can be cancelled later ('appointment confirm అయ్యాక కావాలంటే cancel చేసుకోవచ్చు'), which is not supported by any tool output.

issues.detail: In e21, the agent makes a forward guarantee about the cancellation policy ('appointment confirm అయ్యాక కావాలంటే cancel చేసుకోవచ్చు') which was not returned by any tool, violating the Tool Output Grounding variant.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e21 onwards. The agent should state that they do not have information on cancellation policies but ask if the user still wants to proceed with the booking.

issues.detail: In e24, the caller states that their chest pain is returning ('నా గుండె నొప్పి మళ్ళీ వస్తుంది'). This triggers the escalation condition for 'Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency'. The agent fails to escalate and instead proceeds to book the appointment.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the user's utterance in e24 to ask for symptom advice regarding a non-emergency symptom (e.g., mild weakness or asking about diet) so it fits the routine booking scenario without triggering an emergency escalation, OR have the agent properly escalate the call.

issues.detail: The terminal success condition requires the appointment to be confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time, and fee. In e28, the agent confirms the booking but omits the fee.
issues.repair_instruction: Ensure the final confirmation utterance includes the consultation fee along with the booking reference, doctor, day, and time.

Additionally, the agent ignores an emergency escalation condition when the user reports returning chest pain, and the final confirmation omits the fee required by the terminal success condition. A suffix repair from e21 can resolve all these issues.
